status: Provisional AI review covers all 49 cases; no unresolved missing or truncated review sources. Independent review pending. Not yet applied to primary analyses.
review_method: Read introductions and holding passages; targeted Court-opinion passages for official fallbacks. Not a full-opinion or independent blinded review.
scope_rule: Direct access merits requires a holding on legal protection for obtaining abortions or restrictions on their provision. Speech, protest remedies, standing, procedural dispositions, and related regulation are separate. Null access_direction is not a neutral political outcome.
